sovern_advisor_usage_hold.name: sovern_advisor_usage_hold
sovern_advisor_usage_hold.value: ("sovern_advisor_requests"."state" IN ('reserved','unknown','billing_overrun') AND "sovern_advisor_requests"."booked_nanomyr" = "sovern_advisor_requests"."reservation_nanomyr") OR ("sovern_advisor_requests"."state" IN ('complete','failed') AND "sovern_advisor_requests"."observed_cost_nanomyr" IS NOT NULL AND "sovern_advisor_requests"."observed_cost_nanomyr" = "sovern_advisor_requests"."booked_nanomyr")

sovern_advisor_result.name: sovern_advisor_result
sovern_advisor_result.value: ("sovern_advisor_requests"."state" = 'reserved' AND "sovern_advisor_requests"."result_json" IS NULL) OR ("sovern_advisor_requests"."state" <> 'reserved' AND "sovern_advisor_requests"."result_json" IS NOT NULL)
